2609.19961.title: Neuro-Symbolic Agentic AI for Networked Low-Altitude UAVs
2609.19961.paper_summary: Networked low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) need reliable and adaptive decision-making capabilities to operate under uncertain observations, dynamic environments, and intermittent connectivity, while many existing agentic systems remain limited by hallucination risks, data dependence, and weak generalization. This article investigates neuro-symbolic agentic AI (NSAAI) as a framework for combining neural grounding, symbolic reasoning, and closed-loop agentic interaction to support more reliable and adaptive UAV autonomy. We first examine its capability foundations in data efficiency, compositional generalization, continual learning, and zero-shot transfer, and then develop a reference architecture integrating task and goal management, neuro-symbolic planning, verification and metacognition, skill execution and network interaction, and shared knowledge and memory. An urban fire-inspection case implemented in LAESim illustrates how a UAV can coordinate sensing and cloud access under intermittent connectivity, reuse a verified image-delivery skill, and satisfy explicit evidence conditions before completing the mission. The results illustrate the potential of NSAAI to support reusable skills, evidence-grounded decision-making, and adaptive mission execution in networked UAV systems. We further discuss key research directions in uncertainty-aware reasoning, knowledge and skill expansion, adaptive self-monitoring, and standardized evaluation.
2609.19961.paper_summary_zh: 網絡化的低空無人飛行器（UAV）需要可靠且自適應的決策能力，以便在不確定的觀察、動態環境和間歇性連接下運作，而許多現有的代理系統仍然受到幻覺風險、數據依賴和弱泛化的限制。本文探討神經符號代理人工智慧（NSAAI）作為一種框架，結合神經基礎、符號推理和閉環代理互動，以支持更可靠和自適應的UAV自主性。我們首先檢視其在數據效率、組合泛化、持續學習和零樣本轉移方面的能力基礎，然後開發一個參考架構，整合任務和目標管理、神經符號規劃、驗證和元認知、技能執行和網絡互動，以及共享知識和記憶。在LAESim中實施的城市火災檢查案例展示了UAV如何在間歇性連接下協調感測和雲端訪問，重用經過驗證的影像傳遞技能，並在完成任務之前滿足明確的證據條件。結果顯示NSAAI在支持可重用技能、基於證據的決策和自適應任務執行方面的潛力。我們進一步討論了在不確定性意識推理、知識和技能擴展、自適應自我監控以及標準化評估方面的關鍵研究方向。
